metas.name: Bring Her Back
metas.description: From the Philippou brothers: two siblings are placed with a foster mother whose grief has turned into something monstrous. Relentless and cruel horror that keeps tightening to the end.

metas.name: Speak No Evil
metas.description: In the Danish original, a polite couple spends a weekend with a family they met on holiday and keeps excusing behavior that grows steadily worse. Its ending is famously brutal.

metas.name: Longlegs
metas.description: An FBI agent hunts a satanic serial killer in this cold, precise horror film. The dread builds slowly, and it ends somewhere truly upsetting.

metas.name: Enemy
metas.description: Denis Villeneuve's thriller about a man who finds his exact double. Jake Gyllenhaal stars in a cold, controlled puzzle with one of the most unsettling final shots in modern film.

metas.name: Mother
metas.description: Bong Joon-ho's thriller about a mother who will do anything to clear her son of murder. Dark, darkly funny in places, and ending on a devastating turn.

metas.name: Memories of Murder
metas.description: Bong Joon-ho's serial-killer investigation in 1980s rural Korea, where incompetence and cruelty pile up alongside the bodies. Its ending is unforgettable.

metas.name: Goodnight Mommy
metas.description: In the Austrian original, twin boys become convinced the bandaged woman who came home from surgery isn't their mother. Austere, cruel and extremely tense.

metas.name: The Chaser
metas.description: A disgraced cop turned pimp hunts the serial killer who has taken one of his women. A Korean thriller that is breathless, brutal and doesn't flinch.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description: Lee Chang-dong's slow-burn mystery about a delivery boy, the woman he likes and the smiling rich man who may have made her disappear. The menace keeps growing until a sudden release at the end.

metas.name: Lady Macbeth
metas.description: A young woman sold into a loveless marriage in rural 19th-century England starts an affair and then kills to protect it. It's cold, spare and quietly vicious, and it ends on a chilling note.
